lessons.title: release-lane: spec_decode call sites must route through the lane-gated shim, never call main-only methods unconditionally
lessons.symptom: PR 16575: upstream CI failed both release-leg a2-1 jobs with 'AttributeError: AscendDFlashSpeculator object has no attribute _build_uniform_attn_metadata' at vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py:30 (same shape for AscendDSparkSpeculator at dspark/speculator.py:130), while the flow's pre_ci release smoke was green and the main-lane CI legs passed.
lessons.root_cause: The PR's `build_draft_attn_metadatas` overrides in dflash/dspark/speculator.py replaced the lane-aware `_build_draft_attn_metadata` shim with a DIRECT call to `self._build_uniform_attn_metadata(...)` (a vllm-main-only method from upstream #56181), unconditionally and with no `vllm_version_is("0.28.0")` gate. The shim's lane gate protects only its own callers; call sites that bypass it get main-only code on the v0.28.0 tree, so any dflash/dspark engine start crashes on the release lane. The release smoke could not see it: its MTP case does not reach the dflash/dspark call-site shape. This is the regeneration-drop family again (same as the kimi embed_tokens fix and the shim's own lane gate, both of which a regeneration dropped earlier the same day) — a lane-aware property of the previous tree did not survive regeneration into the new PR.
fix_guidance: Any call site whose shape differs between vllm main and the v0.28.0 release must route through the lane-gated shim (`_build_draft_attn_metadata`, which branches on `vllm_version_is("0.28.0")`) — never call main-only spec_decode methods unconditionally from shared code paths.

If a main-lane direct call is needed for layout/performance, guard it explicitly: `if not vllm_version_is("0.28.0"): <main-only call> else: <release/shim path>` — both branches must name only methods that exist on that lane's tree.

Validate the fix against the CURRENT head tree, not the PR that first carried it: regenerated main2main PRs silently drop earlier fixes, so 'already fixed upstream' is not evidence until the node is green on the latest CI run.

The release smoke now carries dflash + dspark-w4a8 sentinels (flow test_policy.json release_smoke, 2026-09-15): a bypass regression fails pre_ci before the PR ships instead of surfacing in upstream CI's release legs.
